VISHANT MANIAR
	Academic Qualifications

	Course
	Institute
	Year
	Result
	Remarks

	CA Final
	ICAI
	Sept 2025/Jan 2026
	309/600 (51.5%)
	Exemption in IDT

	CA Intermediate
	ICAI
	May/Nov 2022
	410/800 (51.25%)
	Exemptions in Adv. Accounts and Costing

	CA Foundation
	ICAI
	Dec 2020
	233/400 (58.25%)
	Cleared in first attempt

	B. Com
	Saurashtra University
	April 2023
	Division: First Class
	Cleared with first class

	Class XII
	Shree PV Modi School
	March 2020
	563/700 (80.43%)
	Cleared with 97.38 Percentile rank

	Class X
	Shree PV Modi School
	March 2018
	481/600 (80.17%)
	Cleared with 95.06 Percentile rank

	Work Experience

	Article Assistant at DRP and Co LLP                                                                                                                               Period: Nov 2023 to Sept 2025
Pune, Maharashtra

	Statutory 
Audit
		• Audit of a private limited entity in the industrial automation sector, involving TDS compliance verification, GST 
reconciliation procedures, import transactions vouching through Bills of Entry, and ledger scrutiny using SAP for data 
extraction and analytical review in Excel.
	• Audited a Business Correspondent (BC) company, with a gross loan portfolio of more than ₹400 Crores, covering bank 
customer reconciliations, loan origination and recovery processes, GST applicability on BC services, and payroll review, 
along with evaluation of the revenue recognition model to assess timing and accuracy of income recognition.


	Internal 
Audit
		• Performed audits of construction and infrastructure companies across 7 project locations, and an entity operating under 
the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology; reviewed internal controls, operational processes, and 
prepared audit observations and reports.
	• Reviewed procurement cycle controls for a sugar industry client, assessing vendor selection, approval mechanisms, 
and identified control gaps, red flags, and operational risks in the procurement process and reported to management.


	Forensic 
Audit
		• Performed forensic audit support for a fire insurance claim (₹50 crore) for a listed retail clothing company, involving 
inventory existence verification, warehouse capacity and stock movement analysis, reconciliation of purchase records 
with GST filings to substantiate inventory levels, and review of bank-submitted stock audit reports and identification 
the deviations, impacting the claim evaluation.


	Direct Tax
		• Performed tax audits of corporate and non-corporate entities, including a private limited company, subsidiary of a 
foreign company with turnover exceeding ₹3,000 crores, partnership firms, and professionals.
	• Prepared computations, Form 3CD disclosures and transfer pricing reporting requirements.
	• Handled income tax assessments and scrutiny proceedings; drafted replies to notices, assisted in representation before 
the Income Tax Department, prepared and filed appeals (Form 35) for corporates as well as individual clients, gaining 
exposure to contingent tax risks.


	Others
		• Prepared MIS reports for sugar industry clients, identified period-wise analysis, trend identification, and highlighted 
variances for management review.
	• Prepared and reviewed Form 15CA/CB certificates for foreign remittances, ensuring regulatory compliance.
	• Assisted in CMA report preparation for road construction clients, raising ₹20 crore, including Ratio analysis, working 
capital assessment, and evaluation of cash flow analysis.


	Article Assistant at R.B. Shah & Associates                                                                                                                     Period: Jul 2022 to Oct 2023
Rajkot, Gujarat

		• Executed statutory audit and limited review assignments for listed entity with turnover exceeding ₹200 crores and other private 
entities, including SAP based ledger extraction and scrutiny of income and expenses, CSR Compliance as per Section 135 and vouching 
verification.
	• Performed workings and evaluation of employee loan arrangements under Ind AS 109 (Financial Instruments), including verification 
of classification, measurement, and accounting treatment.
	• Assisted in due diligence for an SME company’s IPO, including preparation of SEBI-related certificates and supporting work for offer 
documents.
	• Conducted tax audits and compliance work for corporates and non-corporates, including partnership firms and professionals.


	Extracurriculars

	Leadership 
positions
		• Selected to represent the Gujarat Contingent in the Junior Division Wing, Republic Day Camp (RDC) 2017, held at New 
Delhi, India; awarded Best Parade Commander (Gujarat State) for leadership and drill excellence.
	• Selected as part of designated RDC teams for leadership and ceremonial interactions, including engagements with the 
Chief of Naval Staff and the Hon’ble President of India.


	Technical Skills
		• Microsoft Excel & MS Office – working proficiency
	• SAP – basic working knowledge (audit perspective)
	• Accounting Software – Tally, Miracle


	Certification
		• Completed intensive training in Financial Due Diligence at CA Monk
	• AI workshop - AI Aura | WIRC, Pune



vishantmaniar.ca@gmail.com  |+91 9313252031 | LinkedIn
mailto:vishantmaniar.ca@gmail.com
http://www.linkedin.com/in/ca-vishant-maniar-068840230
